From the first moment of the shot through the third second, a brutal relentless gale slams the wild grass violently flat against the ground without pause, whipping the entire fallow field into a hard pressed-down lean, and yellow broad leaves plus dried grass bits start blasting sideways across the frame at full speed; the willow trees start slamming sideways against the battering wind, and the cement utility pole starts creaking and shuddering under the sustained pressure. From the third second through the sixth second, the gale keeps slamming the field without a single break and without any sign of weakening — it keeps battering in continuous relentless succession, with more yellow leaves, orange-brown dried leaves, willow leaves, dried grass bits, twigs, and   roadside dust blasting across in ae metal sign bolted to the poleswings wildly under the sustained ead shakes violently and creaks, the wild grass keeps getting slammed flat and snapping back as each new gust hits, and the willow trunks keep slamming sideways and bending again as the gale keeps battering. From the sixth second through the ninth second, the wind reaches peak violence and still shows no sign of letting up: a blue plastic bag blasts low acrossd grass, and a thick cloud of grassrolls across the fallow field almost hiding the distant Jiangnan village rooftops. Throughout the entire nine seconds, the wind never stops battering, the wild grass never stops getting slammed flat, the leaves never stop blasting past, and the dense black low cloud stays pressed down covering the entire sky; continuous faint lightning flickers deep inside the heavy clouds overhead, pale flashes pulsing throughout the storm clouds without stopping. Shot on a 16mm fisheye ultra-wide lens in subjective POV.
